title: Run the change in a fresh worktree
goal: A coding agent makes the change and runs the tests in a worktree
acceptance: Fresh worktree from origin/default; the primary checkout is untouched
Diff summary, test result and spend reported to the channel
Cancel stops the agent and leaves the worktree for inspection
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement.
